I made this site because I got annoyed that I couldn't customize my Profile page on Spotify. Below you'll find some music I like, and on the left are links to my playlist repository and some stats about my music listening over the years.

on rotation

According to Spotify: Your musical world is a vibrant blend of modern indie sounds and dynamic hip hop, often with a psychedelic or experimental edge. Artists like Magdelena Bay and Dev Lemons define your taste for art pop and hyperpop, showcasing a preference for intricate electronic textures and catchy melodies. This sits alongside the raw energy of experimental hip hop from JPEGMAFIA and the lyrical depth of Kendrick Lamar. You also frequently return to the folk-infused Americana of Vetiver and Kacy & Clayton, and the atmospheric rock of Radiohead and Tame Impala, revealing a broad appreciation for both organic and synthesized sounds. A common thread is leaning towards neo-psychedelic influences and artists who push genre boundaries, from indie punk to math rock.
